color-contrast.reason: Contrast is owned by the dedicated AAA token gate (pipeline/scripts/check_contrast.py), which verifies every theme and sees through the gradient and texture backgrounds axe cannot. Ignoring the rule here avoids double-counting its false positives; see the comment in .github/workflows/a11y.yml.
color-contrast.review: quarterly, and on any axe-core or pa11y-ci major release

/program/all/.reason: Measured, not assumed: added to the scan set on 2026-09-13 and it reported 'Pa11y timed out (120000ms)' on run 34745503419 while the other 33 URLs passed. This rollup renders every tracked feed on one page (2,451 rows, 1.31 MB in the CI render, three and a half times the paginated /agencies/), and axe cannot finish it. A larger timeout would buy a pass that expires as the corpus grows and would make a required check flaky for every pull request, which is worse than a recorded gap. What is unscanned is the member list, whose row markup is the same on every rollup; the offer block this page carries is byte-identical to the one on /program/california/ and /program/yolo-county/, both scanned above and both at 0 errors.
/program/all/.review: when the rollup page stops rendering every member at once -- pagination, as /agencies/ already has, would make it scannable
